answer:
The first person to hold the title “Prime Minister” (Chairman of the Council of Ministers) of the Russian Empire was **Sergei Yulyevich Witte**.  
He formally assumed office on **19 October 1905**, when Tsar Nicholas II issued the decree that created the post as part of the reforms following the 1905 Revolution. Witte remained in that role until 22 April 1906.
